definitions.gloss: to surface; to rise to the surface
definitions.explanation: To come up from below the surface of water or another medium. Used for submarines, divers, or objects rising through liquid.

definitions.gloss: to emerge; to come to light; to come to the fore
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, for issues, candidates, or possibilities to emerge or become apparent. Common in news and formal contexts.

notes:
Combines ⟦{浮|う}く→浮く：00413_uku⟧ (to float) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upward). The literal sense describes physical rising to a surface; the figurative sense is extremely common in news reporting and formal discussion for issues, names, or facts becoming apparent.

USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is more frequently encountered in daily life than the literal sense. It often appears in news headlines and political reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮上|ふじょう}する — a problem comes to light
- ⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮上|ふじょう}する — suspicion emerges
- ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{浮上|ふじょう}する — to emerge as a candidate
- ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浮上|ふじょう}する — to rise to the sea surface

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧ — to float up; to come to mind; more colloquial and versatile
- ⟦{表面化|ひょうめんか}→表面化：16295_hyoumenka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to come to the surface (figurative only); emphasizes something hidden becoming visible
